snippet.title: CATGIRL - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3569430/Catgirl/

"Catgirl! The RPG where you're a cat and also a girl. I bet you'd like that, wouldn't you? You little freak. Haha jk, ur good."

I made a game!! With the help of the lovely vickisigh and ichigo on art and City Girl on.... everything else! It is free on Mac and PC and comes out May 23! Just 2 weeks away! WOOO!!

The OST for the game will come out on streaming and bandcamp May 23rd as well! Yaaaayyy

City Girl: https://city-girl.carrd.co/
vickisigh: https://vickisigh.carrd.co/
ichigo: https://x.com/ichigogoooooooo
